summary: Ona for Open Source gives maintainers and core contributors of active, well-established open-source projects up to $200 per month in Ona credits. The amount granted depends on the degree of the applicant's open-source contributions. Applicants submit a form with their GitHub profile and the repositories they maintain or contribute to; most applications are processed within a few days. No end date is stated.
claim_steps: Open the Ona for Open Source page and start the application
Provide your GitHub profile and the repositories you maintain or contribute to
Wait for review (most applications are processed within a few days)

social_proof.title: Ona for Open Source | Free Credits for Maintainers
social_proof.text: Up to $200 in monthly free credits for maintainers and contributors. You are a maintainer or core contributor of at least one active, well-established open-source project. Most applications are processed within a few days.
